description: Google web search via Serper: returns organic results (title, link, snippet, position), an answer box if present, and a knowledge graph summary. Accepts query, result count (max 20), and optional country code (gl) and location for geo-targeted results.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Serper API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

location.description: Location string, e.g. "San Francisco, California, United States"

name: search
